messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-01-08] standup/atlas/2025-01-08: For the record, Ledger is owned by team Atlas.
- [2026-03-17] standup/cinder/2026-03-17: Reminder: notifier is owned by team Cinder.
- [2025-01-17] standup/cinder/2025-01-17: The product catalog lives with the Cinder team. Cinder owns the indexer.
- [2026-04-29] handover/2026-04-29-ledger: Cinder is taking over the ledger from team Boreal, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
- [2025-07-18] handover/2025-07-18-auth-gateway-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2025-07-01: auth-gateway went to team Boreal, not the Cinder team. Cinder never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2025-12-10] handover/2025-12-10-ledger: Atlas handed the ledger to the Boreal team today; Priya wrote up the handover doc for Lena.
- [2025-01-20] standup/ember/2025-01-20: Team Ember owns the job scheduler.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09: The event bus is a the Boreal team service. The Boreal team owns notifier.
- [2025-04-10] standup/ember/2025-04-10: Reminder: the authentication gateway is owned by the Ember team.
- [2025-01-20] standup/dune/2025-01-20-2: Team Dune owns the reporting service.
- [2025-01-20] standup/dune/2025-01-20: For the record, image-resizer is owned by team Dune.
- [2025-06-25] handover/2025-06-25-reporting: Ownership change: the reports pipeline now sits with team Ember. The Dune team no longer owns it.
- [2025-09-15] standup/boreal/2025-09-15-2: Team Boreal still owns search-indexer, in case anyone asks.
- [2026-04-22] handover/2026-04-22-search-indexer: Ownership change: the search indexer now sits with the Boreal team. The Dune team no longer owns it.
- [2026-05-01] standup/cinder/2026-05-01: From today the ledger service deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC instead of on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.
- [2025-12-15] standup/cinder/2025-12-15: Team change: Diego leaves team Cinder and joins team Ember, effective today. With Diego moving on, Yuki is on call for the Cinder team from today.
- [2025-09-19] standup/boreal/2025-09-19: We decided that reporting will read from the event-bus instead of querying the ledger directly. The reason: the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. That removes the dependency on Ledger from the reporting service.
- [2025-07-03] handover/2025-07-03-reporting-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2025-06-25: reporting went to Boreal, not Ember. Team Ember never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2025-01-08] standup/cinder/2025-01-08: For the org chart: Yuki and Diego are on team Cinder.
- [2025-02-06] standup/atlas/2025-02-06: Billing-api calls the ledger service for invoice postings, so treat the ledger service as a hard dependency of billing-api.
- [2025-02-17] standup/cinder/2025-02-17: Reminder from the Cinder team: page Yuki Tanaka for anything this cycle, not Diego.
- [2025-01-16] standup/cinder/2025-01-16: Diego Alvarez takes the first the Cinder team on-call shift of the year.
- [2025-11-25] standup/cinder/2025-11-25: Team Cinder on-call swapped this morning. Diego carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2025-10-02] standup/cinder/2025-10-02: On-call rotation: Yuki is primary for team Cinder starting today; Diego is off rotation.
- [2025-09-26] standup/cinder/2025-09-26: The Cinder team saw that the notifier's request volume halved following the client rollout; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2026-04-17] standup/cinder/2026-04-17: Observation from the Cinder team: after the runtime upgrade, the authentication gateway's cold start time tripled.
- [2025-05-15] standup/dune/2025-05-15-2: Reminder: the job scheduler is owned by Dune.
- [2026-05-01] standup/cinder/2026-05-01-2: Observation from the Cinder team: after the marketing send, the flags service's queue depth hit 50,000.
- [2025-12-15] standup/cinder/2025-12-15-2: Observation from the Cinder team: after the retention change, the catalog service's disk usage jumped 30 percent.
- [2025-05-28] standup/ember/2025-05-28: Observation from Ember: after the cache change, Ledger's memory use grew steadily for a week. Reminder: Oskar Lind is on call for team Ember this cycle.
- [2026-03-05] standup/boreal/2026-03-05: As before, billing-api needs Ledger to work.
- [2025-12-08] standup/dune/2025-12-08: Tomasz picked up the Dune on-call shift from Farah today. Team Dune saw that the ledger's p99 latency doubled following Tuesday's deploy; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-08-29] standup/cinder/2025-08-29-2: The Cinder team noticed that search-indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change and pinged the owners.

Question: Which team owned the ledger before Cinder took it over?

message.reasoning:
The question asks: Which team owned the ledger before Cinder took it over?

Timeline of ledger ownership:
- 2025-01-08: Ledger owned by team Atlas.
- 2025-12-10: Atlas handed the ledger to Boreal team.
- 2026-04-29: Cinder taking over the ledger from team Boreal, effective today.

So before Cinder took it over, the owner was team Boreal (the handover note says Cinder is taking over from team Boreal).

Answer: Boreal.
